narrative.intro: Moeve S A has $274M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, spread across 17 awards with an average award size of $16.1M. Obligations are up 108.0% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year trace a volatile but growing pattern: FY21 showed $69.8M, FY22 showed $107M, FY23 showed $215M, FY24 showed $158M, FY25 showed $132M, and FY26 shows $274M. The FY2026 total is a partial, fiscal-year-to-date figure and represents the largest single-year obligation total in the listed span. The award count of 17 combined with an average award size of $16.1M indicates that FY2026 growth reflects both larger individual awards and a concentration of obligation value into a relatively small number of contracts. Contractors and procurement analysts should expect that headline totals reflect concentrated award activity rather than many small purchases, given the average award size and the total obligation amount.
